description_en: Changes the domain name that is attached to a Cloud DNS product
description_zh: 更换云解析产品绑定的域名
name: ChangeDomainOfDnsProduct

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.
Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is zh
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
取值：

zh：中文
en：英文

默认值为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Cloud DNS product.
You can obtain the ID by calling ListCloudGtmInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)
parameters.help_zh:
云解析产品ID。
<props="china">可通过调用 ListCloudGtmInstances (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_14_34.14ce3409EfbfOE) 获取。</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用 ListCloudGtmInstances  (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取。</props>
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name that you want to attach. If you leave this parameter empty, the currently attached domain name is detached
parameters.help_zh: 目标绑定域名，如不填写，则为解绑
parameters.name: new_domain

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully attach the domain name.
Valid values:

false: No

true: Yes

The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制绑定。
取值：

false：否
true：是

默认值为false
parameters.name: force

OriginalDomain.description_en: The domain name that was originally attached. If this parameter is empty, it indicates that this is the first time a domain name is attached to the product
OriginalDomain.description_zh: 原始绑定的域名，如果为空，则为第一次绑定
